newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia car sales up 22.6 pct in June.
newsitem.headline: Colombia car sales up 22.6 pct in June.

text.p: Vehicle sales in Colombia rose 22.6 percent in June compared with the same month last year, industry officials said Thursday.
Car sales increased 26 percent to 7,493, while commercial vehicle sales rose 16 percent to 4,356, GM-Colmotores, the Colombian unit of General Motors Corp, said in a press statement.
In the first half of the year vehilcle sales have risen 11.2 percent compared to the same period last year.
In June, South Korean manufacturer Daewoo increased sales by 260.8 percent to 855. Ford Motor Co increased sales 73.6 percent to 814.
Overall June imports rose rose 59.9 percent to 2,876 vehicles.
Colombia's Mazda assemblers Compania Colombiana Automotriz saw its June sales drop by 16 percent to 1,644 vehicles.
